faqs.answer: Dot shut down in October 2025 and the app stopped working. Former users need a living product, ideally one that cannot be shut down on them.
faqs.question: Why do I need a Dot alternative?

faqs.answer: GAIA is fully open source and self-hostable via Docker. No company decision can take it away from you.
faqs.question: Can GAIA shut down like Dot did?

faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA remembers your preferences and history across conversations and tools, then acts on that memory instead of just chatting about it.
faqs.question: Does GAIA remember me like Dot did?

name: Dot
painPoints: Dot shut down in October 2025, so the app no longer works at all
Closed product meant users got no vote and no export path
Companion-only: it chatted but never touched email or tasks
iPhone-only with no web, desktop, or messaging presence
All memory lived on their servers and left with them
tagline: The companion is gone. The habit can stay.
whyPeopleLook: Dot users lost more than an app: they lost a daily habit and a memory of past conversations. The shutdown taught the real lesson, which is to rebuild on ground nobody can pull away. People searching for a Dot alternative want the companionship back plus a guarantee it cannot vanish again, which is exactly what open source gives.
